verified_errors.claim: Persians supported an Ionian revolt against Ionians in499BCE.
verified_errors.correction: The Ionian revolt opposed Persian rule; Athens and Eretria aided the Ionians, who attacked Sardis.

verified_errors.claim: The sanctuary burned at Sardis in this episode was Artemis’s temple.
verified_errors.correction: Herodotus identifies the burned local sanctuary as Cybebe/Cybele.
